description: AI agents can be designed to satisfy the actus reus (the physical act) of a crime even if they lack the human-like mens rea (mental state) required for traditional criminal liability.

instances.assertion: AI agents can be designed to satisfy the actus reus (the physical act) of a crime even if they lack the human-like mens rea (mental state) required for traditional criminal liability.
AI agents can be designed to shadow experts to learn and evolve after launch.
